notes: gemma-3-270m-it_npu-srq_c896.litertlm of mlboydaisuke/gemma-3-270m-it-NPU-LiteRT: google/gemma-3-270m-it (Gemma terms) as a static-range-quantized LiteRT-LM file for the Qualcomm HTP that the phone compiles at engine creation (on-device JIT); KV cache 896 tokens; its rotary-position ranges end where its calibration reached: position 383 in the 128-token prefill and 359 in decode (the Hub card). Added 2026-08-24 (Hub commit 5336cadb); main 6724a0f2 at the read, 456853286 B, sha256 baafebc1c68ab3667740d478dfe8d1bb5be75689cce06108d10a3188b3e02bcc. Measured 2026-11-07 16:55:42-17:03:34 JST on a Galaxy S26 in hold 3 (a speed run planned before its numbers were taken): three processes of this file alternated with three of gemma-3-270m-it_npu-srq_c896_rope1024.litertlm (earlier, new, new, earlier, earlier, new), each started at Thermal Status 0 with no CPU cap; that file's medians in the same hold 19066.51 / 191.40 tok/s (its own record). Not entered here: holds 1-2 of the same day (the PyPI litert-lm-api 0.19.1 Android wheel: the 45-prompt gate and the 40 long GSM8K prompts). The Hub card's 2026-08 phone rows are of a sibling build, not of these bytes.
quantization: static range quantization for the Qualcomm HTP (litert-torch's experimental npu_export at 8379afb with the valid_mask fix of PR #1178, which upstream main carries since d49f1ba6; its gemma3-270m Qualcomm SM8850 preset; stages 1-3, no ahead-of-time step): int8 weights (the preset's recipe dynamic_wi8_afp32) and 16-bit integer activations at the ranges of 10 calibration prompts (the first 10 of npu_export's sample calibration prompts) with up to 32 decode steps each, the rotary-position graphs included (their position range ends at 383 in the 128-token prefill and 359 in decode: int16 scales 0.0116886 and 0.0109561); one prefill signature of 128 tokens and decode, with a fixed 896-token KV cache; the embedding lookup (tf_lite_embedder) and the rotary, mask and cache-update graphs (tf_lite_aux) in sections of their own
